page_title: AnveVoice — AI Voice Assistant for Your Website

sources.entry: 27. AnveVoice - Voice AI agent for websites with agentic DOM actions — navigates pages, fills forms, clicks buttons autonomously. 50+ languages, <700ms latency, one-line embed. Free tier.

summary.name: AnveVoice
summary.one_liner: AnveVoice is a voice AI agent you add to a website with one script tag, which answers visitors in 50+ languages and acts on the page by navigating, filling forms and completing tasks.
use_cases: let website visitors book appointments by voice
voice-guided form filling on a website
multilingual customer support on a site
voice navigation for accessibility and mobility
guided voice shopping or checkout on e-commerce sites
self-hosted voice assistant for a web application
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a real-time voice agent added to a website through a single script tag, trained on the site's own content. It answers visitors in 50+ languages and performs actions on the page, such as scrolling, navigating to pages, filling and submitting forms, and completing bookings or checkout. The page reports a 487ms median response time. An open-source version (AnveVoice OSS) is described as runnable with Docker and Compose, with swappable model providers (Gemini Live, OpenAI Realtime, or an STT→LLM→TTS pipeline). A dashboard shows sessions, messages, completion rates and token usage.
notable: Agentic DOM actions: the agent navigates pages, fills forms and completes multi-step tasks by voice, not just answers questions
One script tag embed with no SDK or build step; loads asynchronously
Self-hostable open-source build (AnveVoice OSS) with Docker + Compose and provider-agnostic model backends
Free plan includes agentic actions and 50K tokens per month
caveats: Source-available under Business Source License 1.1, not an OSI open-source license until it converts to Apache 2.0 on 2030-07-06
Free plan limited to 50K tokens/month and 1 voice agent; paid tiers are $39/mo and $129/mo
Page's comparison table is marketing from the vendor; the 487ms latency figure is the vendor's own median claim
